mapper.select: SELECT homepage_id, locker_number, request_number, member_id, member_name, TO_CHAR(request_date,'yyyy-MM-dd HH24:MI:SS') AS request_date, locker_password, reservation_step, reg_no, book_regno, book_isbn, book_name, loan_date, reservation_yn, cancel_reason FROM UNTACT_BOOK_RESERVATION WHERE homepage_id = #{homepage_id} AND reservation_yn = 'N' ORDER BY request_number
mapper.insert:

INSERT INTO UNTACT_BOOK_RESERVATION ( homepage_id, locker_number, request_number, member_id, member_name, request_date, locker_password, reservation_step, reg_no, book_regno, book_isbn, book_name, loan_date, reservation_yn, cancel_reason ) VALUES ( #{homepage_id}, (SELECT NVL(MAX(locker_number),0)+1 FROM UNTACT_BOOK_RESERVATION), #{request_number}, #{member_id}, #{member_name}, TO_DATE(#{request_date},'yyyy-MM-dd HH24:MI:SS'), #{locker_password}, '접수', #{reg_no}, #{book_regno}, #{book_isbn}, #{book_name}, #{loan_date}, 'N', #{cancel_reason} )
